final: WITH t AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, r.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY s.transref, r.ordertypedist), g AS (SELECT r.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS grp_short FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY r.ordertypedist) SELECT t.transref, t.ordertypedist, t.avg_short, t.avg_opt, t.avg_short * 1.0 / NULLIF(g.grp_short, 0) AS ratio FROM t LEFT JOIN g ON g.ordertypedist IS t.ordertypedist ORDER BY (ratio IS NULL), ratio DESC LIMIT 10
